use_case_summary: Primary objective: enterprise search across 20–50M internal docs for customer support and trading compliance. Pipeline: query -> vector similarity -> 2-stage rerank (lightweight bi-encoder pre-rank then cross-encoder rerank for top-N). Requirements: EU/UK residency, sub-150ms p99 in primary region, predictable cost per query metric for budgeting.
tech_requirements: Indexing scale: plan to index 20M–50M documents initially; embeddings pre-computed & stored; incremental updates daily.
Embedding dim & model: 384–768 dim; open to Redwood-curated open models; prefer ability to pin model versions for reproducibility.
Throughput targets: baseline 100 qps sustained, peak bursts to 400 qps; goal automated burst routing to dedicated capacity.
Latency targets: p50 < 50ms, p95 < 90ms, p99 < 150ms for regional queries (eu-west-2).
Rerank pipeline: pre-filter 200 candidates via ANN -> bi-encoder score -> cross-encoder rerank top 10; cross-encoder is cost driver and should support fallback to cheaper model when load high.
Cost target: aiming for amortized cost-per-utterance < $0.005 equivalent (converted to GBP).
Caching: must support prefix/KV caching for repeated queries and TTL controls per dataset.
Observability: per-request token-level cost, latency breakdown by stage (ANN lookup, bi-encoder, cross-encoder), tracing hooks into Splunk/Datadog.
Data residency & encryption: all embeddings and request logs stored in EU/UK regions; KMS keys managed by customer; immutable audit logs for 12 months.
poc_scope: Ingest 10M doc subset (subset representative of trading docs).
Run embedding generation + bulk upload into Redwood Dedicated vector store in eu-west-2.
Execute simulated traffic: 100 qps sustained for 1 hour, several 10-min 400 qps bursts; measure p50/p95/p99 latency and cost breakdown.
Validate 2-stage rerank: compare baseline internal reranker vs Redwood cross-encoder results for MAP@10 and latency impact.
Deliverability: provide runbook for failover to eu-west-1 and explain routing policy / fallback thresholds.
decision_criteria: Meets p99 latency target under sustained+burst traffic in eu-west-2.
Clear and auditable data residency commitments + DPA addendum accepted.
Predictable unit economics: transparent per-query pricing and tooling to estimate monthly cost at indexing scale.
Operational controls: SSO + audit logging + customer-managed KMS integration available in Private/Dedicated deployments.
Seamless multi-region routing with documented failover and limited cold-starts on fallback region.
